title: Renewal planning: target $/1M, low-latency route add, and next steps
text:
Renewal planning: target $/1M, low-latency route add, and next steps

['From: Samantha Li <samantha@cloudnexus.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudNexus Procurement <procure@cloudnexus.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from renewal call — target $/1M and low-latency route

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the clarity on Dedicated vs Hosted lane behavior. Two quick asks from our side as we prep finance:

1) Target economics: finance wants a target $/1M tokens number we can use for internal forecasting for the 12-month renewal. Can you confirm a conservative blended target and an aggressive target (assuming 40% volume step-up)?

2) Low-latency route: we discussed adding a low-latency route for our customer-facing chat (p95 < 250ms). What’s the expected uplift to unit cost if we route 25% of tokens through that lane?

3) Docs: can you send the updated renewal proposal with blended bands and a sample 1M-token unit-econ calc? Procurement would like a single document to circulate (PDF preferred).

We’re aiming to lock terms by 4/27 to keep our go-live timeline.

Thanks — happy to jump on another 15-min call if helpful.

— Samantha
Samantha Li
Head of Platform
CloudNexus
', 'From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@cloudnexus.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up from renewal call — target $/1M and low-latency route

Samantha — thanks for the summary and the timeline. Putting in the notes and looping in Ben + Karthik for numbers + proposal doc.

High level answers below; attaching a draft proposal and a simple workbook. Ben / Karthik — see questions inline and can you fill out the conservative vs aggressive targets and the LL-route uplift?

— Conservative blended $/1M (current mix): $950 / 1M tokens (includes hashing for embeddings where used)
— Aggressive blended $/1M (40% volume increase + quantized model mix): $720 / 1M tokens

Low-latency route uplift: estimate +27% unit cost if 25% tokens routed to low-latency pool (we assume smaller batch sizes, reserved low-latency capacity).

Attachments: redwood-pricing-proposal-v2.pdf, cloudnexus-volume-estimates.xlsx

Next steps:
- Ben: can you confirm the blended breakouts per model (gpt-like, quantized, embedding heavy)?
- Karthik: can you sketch a blended discount schedule for a 12m commit with a 30%/40% step-up cadence?

Samantha: if those numbers look ok we’ll produce a final PDF with the exact bands and a sign-ready contract.

Cheers,
Monica

', 'From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from renewal call — target $/1M and low-latency route

Adding the math we used for Monica’s quick numbers — pasted below and also in the workbook. I flagged a few assumptions; if CloudNexus has different model mix we’ll update.

--- unit-econ sketch (per 1M tokens) ---
Assumptions (current mix):
- 50% standard generation (medium-length, batching friendly)
- 30% quantized-heavy (cheaper per token)
- 20% embeddings/rerank (higher cost per request but lower tokens)

Conservative blended cost: $950 / 1M tokens
Breakdown: std gen $520, quantized $240, embeddings $190

Aggressive (40% volume growth + higher quantized share): $720 / 1M tokens
Breakdown: std gen $470, quantized $180, embeddings $70 (share shifts)

Low-latency route uplift (25% of tokens):
- Low-latency pool cost delta: +40% for the tokens routed there due to reserved capacity and smaller batches
- Effective blended uplift = 0.25 * 40% = +10% overall; but because low-latency traffic is disproportionately generation, we model a +27% to generation line which nets to roughly +18% blended. Monica used +27% to be conservative; can confirm if finance needs a tighter number.

I attached the sheet: cloudnexus-volume-estimates.xlsx — it has scenario tabs (current, +20%, +40%) and a quick pivot for $/1M at different route mixes.

Ben
Ben Carter | Sales Strategy, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
', 'From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha@cloudnexus.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from renewal call — target $/1M and low-latency route

Monica / Ben / Samantha — quick note on suggested commercial bands for a 12-month renewal with staged step-ups. These are rough and meant to map to internal discount matrix.

Option A (Conservative commit):
- Base: up to 3M tokens / month: standard list rates, blended ~ $950 / 1M
- Step-up band 1: 3-6M / month: 8% discount on list (~ $874 / 1M)
- Band 2: 6M+ / month: 15% discount (~ $808 / 1M)

Option B (Growth commitment, 12m with 40% expected growth):
- Base tier: 0-3M: 5% off list
- 3-9M: 18% off list (applies once commit hits)
- 9M+: 28% off list

Low-latency add-on: flat multiplier to generation tokens routed to the LL route: +22% on generation list price (we can take this lower for a committed LL capacity purchase). If CloudNexus wants reserved pods for LL traffic we can give a deeper offset (flat fee + smaller % uplift).

If this looks directionally correct I’ll draft a short appendix to the PDF to capture the bands and any reserved LL capacity pricing.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Follow-up from renewal call — target $/1M and low-latency route

Thanks all — this is very helpful and we like Option B for predictability. A few follow-ups:

- Can you produce a single-page appendix showing the blended $/1M under Option B for current, +20%, +40% scenarios (our CFO wants the three-line view)?
- Procurement would like the PDF sent to procure@cloudnexus.com and a DocuSign link for signature-ready terms.
- Regarding low-latency: we’re interested in a reserved LL pool option if you can give a fixed monthly seat fee + smaller percentage uplift. Could you include that in the appendix as "Reserved LL pod (example)"?

If you send the PDF by EOD PT on Tuesday (4/27) we’ll review and aim to route to legal the same day.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Samantha
Samantha Li
Head of Platform, CloudNexus
